notes.note: Jackson was great with 9 tackles being the key to his game. Back to back big scores from him is certainly helpful this time of year. There is a risk that he will be given a rest this week.
Jackson was huge against Gawn with 7 tackles 8 clearances and 17 disposals for his biggest score since round  15. This is what those that held were looking for from him.
Jackson still can't put up those big scores we saw early in the year and despite 2 goals and 5 clearances he struggled to score this week against English.
Jackson didn't have it all his own way as his lean run of scoring continues. Just 19 disposals at 63% for the Docker star with this his fourth in the 90s in a row.
Just three of his 16 disposals were kicks and he gave away 4 free kicks as Jackson did have a battle against Sweet. Three in a row now under 100 for the first time this season.
Jackson had just 3 kicks with 14 handballs. But he also had game highs in contested possessions with 14 and equal high clearances with 7. A tough match up and this was a good performance.
2 goals from 12 disposals for Jackson with his 31 hit outs. Not a huge score from him but still solid for owners. Darcy didn't have a big score so there is a chance that experiment may end.
Jackson was again outstanding with his two goals and 4 clearances. He is still a great option for your sides as his game is a very SuperCoach friendly one.

The complete all round game from Jackson. He finished with 28 disposals and had 9 tackles as he led the game in contested possessions with 15 and added a game high 6 clearances.  He is one that many other coaches will be looking at.
Jackson was back to his best after a quieter week. He dominated the ruck and amassed 19 clearances and kicked 3 goals.
Jackson battled against Draper and posted his second under 100 in the last three weeks. Just the 15 disposals for him.
Jackson had a tougher night than normal against Marshall and De Koning and after a quiet first term he did come good with 18 contested possessions and 7 clearances to go with 22 disposals.
Jackson was very quiet in the first half with just 16 points at the half but a 35 point third term helped us. The conditions weren't kind to him so don't worry about this one.

Jackson was outstanding and had his third 140+ score in a row now as he lit up the last 5 mins of the game to get the Dockers over the line. He had 49 points in the last term and if you can get him in he is a VC and C option each week.

Jackson is the one player we must have this season. This is back to back 140+ scores and his third of that mark this season. He had 18 disposals but he dominated the hit outs with 36 and had 12 contested possessions.
Jackson is having a season out of the box with another best on ground performance with 31 hitouts 2 goals and 22 disposals. He is one that you must consider.
Jackson had his way with the inexperienced Eagles rucks. His last three have now been either 125 or 126. He is a great option. Whilst Darcy is out of the side he is playing that scoring friendly role
Jackson had to play in ruck for most of the game after Darcy left the game early. He is having a stellar season so far and will be the number 1 ruck with Darcy out this week.

Jackson top scored for the Dockers and nearly made his high BE. He was great in the ruck and often took the ball and cleared it having 14 contested possessions and 7 clearances. One you have to consider.
Jackson kept his 100+ streak going. Certainly has been a great selection for our sides and he is one that we should be looking at getting and particularly if he gets DPP.
Jackson spent time as a midfielder as well as a ruck again this week as he continues to post some big scores. He could be the answer as one of your two rucks this season.

Jackson was someone that floated in and out of a lot of R2 positions during preseason and those that stuck with him were rewarded. Big game with 18 contested possession and 10 clearances to lead the game in both categories.
